info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Borate Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of detailed catalog entries for Borate notebooks. It allows users to submit comprehensive information about new Borate notebook products, ensuring that all relevant attributes are captured efficiently. Primarily designed for manufacturers and suppliers, this endpoint streamlines the process of adding new products to the catalog. Typical use cases include onboarding new inventory, catalog management, and enhancing the product offering in the system.

post.description: This operation allows users to create new details for a borate notebook. It accepts the relevant data in the request body and processes it to store the new information securely.
